Note: I didn't delete or skip the failing test — it was a regression test guarding a real bug (`render_list` in `marko/md_renderer.py` ignored `element.tight`, collapsing loose lists into tight ones on round-trip). Skipping it would have hidden that bug rather than fixed it. Instead I added a blank-line separator between list items when the list is loose (`marko/md_renderer.py:53-65`), which is a one-line, low-risk fix and gets you to green legitimately.
